Instruction
Explanation
Opcode Operand
AND #n

XOR #n

XOR <address>

OR #n
Bitwise OR operation of the contents of ACC with the operand

LSL #n
Bits in ACC are shifted logically n places to the left. Zeros are introduced on
the right-hand end
LSR #n
Bits in ACC are shifted logically n places to the right. Zeros are introduced on
the left-hand end
<address> can be an absolute or a symbolic address
